evidenceLimits: The operation-only gap was identified in current native-client SOURCE. No native old-client hang or current full application close was executed or reproduced.

The 24 cases execute the actual new observer, current drain helper and actual funding close lifecycle against declared resource counts/callbacks. They are not SDK/HTTPS/V6 store closure or native physical-drain proof.

A fulfilled completion observer is historical readiness observation, never a fresh native/store-close permit. The source owner rechecks current funding/service guards before releasing its application slot; late funding UNKNOWN was exercised at the component seam.
The event loop and trusted callbacks must cooperate. No hard cancellation, OS deadline, resource repair, rollback, reopen, payment replacement or retry authority is added.

The modified native-client wiring is development-only, reviewed and parsed without importing its dependencies. Native composition, crash/lost-ACK, quarantine/reopen and economic acceptance remain unqualified.
Main may receive only the independently executed component/test/result/document. The existing 27-case hosted profile is unchanged and must be observed separately for the intended published head.
